title: Swedish court says Google is to pay $1.5 billion to Klarna in antitrust damages
title_zh: 瑞典法院称谷歌将向 Klarna 支付 15 亿美元反垄断赔偿
summary: STOCKHOLM, July 1 (Reuters) - A Swedish court said on Wednesday Alphabet's Google is to pay the equivalent of around 14.3 billion Swedish crowns  ($1.5 billion) in antitrust damages to Klarna's price
summary_zh: 斯德哥尔摩，7 月 1 日（路透社）——瑞典一家法院周三表示，Alphabet 旗下的谷歌将就 Klarna 的收购价格支付相当于约 143 亿瑞典克朗（15 亿美元）的反垄断赔偿金

title: EU says it held 'constructive' talks with Apple CEO Cook after Siri AI clash
title_zh: 欧盟表示在 Siri AI 冲突后与苹果首席执行官库克进行了“建设性”会谈
summary: European technology chief Henna Virkkunen held "constructive" talks with Apple CEO Tim Cook this week, a European Commission spokesperson ‌said on Wednesday, after the two sides clashed over the roll-out of ‌Siri AI in Europe.
summary_zh: 欧盟委员会发言人周三表示，欧洲技术主管 Henna Virkkunen 本周与苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克举行了“建设性”会谈，此前双方就在欧洲推出 Siri AI 问题发生了冲突。
